must_have_properties: Runs over the PCIe Flex Bus; CXL vs PCIe selected via the PCIe Alternate Protocol negotiation.
Three sub-protocols on one link: CXL.io (mandatory) + CXL.cache + CXL.mem (per device type).
CXL.cache + CXL.mem share a common link/transaction layer, separate from CXL.io.
ARB/MUX multiplexes the CXL.io stack against the CXL.cache/CXL.mem stack before the PCIe PHY.
Asymmetric coherence: the host memory controller is the sole cache agent.
CXL 3.0: 256-byte Flit on the PCIe 6.0 PAM-4 PHY at 64 GT/s.
CXL 3.0 enhanced coherency: Back-Invalidation (BI) replaces 1.x bias modes.
CXL 3.0: memory pooling + memory sharing; Port-Based Routing up to 4,096 nodes.
Backward compatible with CXL 1.1/2.0 and with plain PCIe.
must_not_have_properties: Implementing symmetric CPU-CPU coherence (CXL coherence is asymmetric by design).
Carrying CXL.cache/CXL.mem on the CXL.io link/transaction layer (they use the separate common layer).
Claiming CXL 3.0 features (256B Flit, BI, sharing, PBR fabric) when negotiated down to CXL 1.x/2.0.
Operating coherently when the Flex Bus negotiated plain PCIe (no CXL).

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Alternate Protocol negotiation does not converge; link falls back to PCIe or fails to train.
Corrupted CXL.cache/CXL.mem Flit; link-layer retry (replay) invoked.
Illegal D2H/H2D or M2S/S2M opcode sequence, or back-invalidation to a non-cached line.
Agent consumes data marked poisoned without honoring the poison indication.
Fatal error fails to set/propagate the viral state to dependent agents.
Type 3 device reports an uncorrectable error via S2M response status.

fields.min_link_constraint: A CXL link must at minimum support CXL.io and successfully complete Flex Bus Alternate-Protocol negotiation to CXL mode; CXL.cache and/or CXL.mem are present per the device type.
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: PERST# deassertion triggers PCIe Flex Bus training + Alternate-Protocol negotiation; coherent CXL.cache/CXL.mem traffic begins only after CXL.io enumeration, HDM Decoder programming, and ARB/MUX activation.
